performanceCaveat: Shared desktop Intel Iris Xe. These are two 20-second public-origin samples, not a matched 9.2 comparison or physical-phone measurements. Manifest-verified asset bytes were cached locally; navigation, authentication, signed saves and native APIs stayed remote through the public TLS hostname via SSH CONNECT. Actual served bytes were hashed separately on the server. This is not a network-startup benchmark. Earlier interrupted/contended diagnostic runs and the temporary stage-routing authentication failure remain under artifacts and are not counted as successful benchmarks.

routingIncident.cause: An independently created Eight Ball stage inherited the production VIRTUAL_HOST after the UI suites completed. Requests could reach its local-origin server.
routingIncident.fix: Removed VIRTUAL_HOST and VIRTUAL_PORT from that stage while preserving its image, mounts, networks and loopback-only review port.
routingIncident.verification: Repeated all 94 public TLS hashes, native pins, production host registration enumeration, Origin acceptance and both authenticated native-driving performance samples.
routingIncident.initialPerformanceSetupFailure: 403 at authentication; no driving benchmark occurred. Diagnostic retained and excluded from performance figures.
